prompts.title: ХРЮ-БОУЛИНГ
prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE landscape 16:9 visual reference as a PLAUSIBLE ACTUAL SCREENSHOT of a SMALL SIMPLE 2D indie game starring a PIG. Not a poster, not concept key art, not an illustration or diorama. Must immediately communicate the core mechanic through visible interactive objects and action. Small game sprites in gameplay scale, sharp collision geometry, restrained effects, quiet simplified backgrounds, minimal small native HUD. All characters and scenery purely 2D, no 3D renders, no photorealism. NO HORSES and no bubble guns. One coherent screen, no collage or comparison board. Add a small readable concept number and title at top center, visually separate from gameplay. Exact small title: "01 / ХРЮ-БОУЛИНГ".
A physics launching game, exactly SIDE VIEW. A squat cheerful pink pig wearing a padded orange helmet has just been launched from a springy wooden launch ramp at left toward a compact stack of wooden crates, tin cans and three watermelons on a platform at right. Pig is MID-FLIGHT at normal small gameplay scale, scarf trailing, a SHORT faint dotted arc behind it indicating the recent trajectory. The pig hits a crate near base of the stack, two cans tumble, a watermelon rolls toward edge, little score popups "+50" at impact. Show a visible small spring launcher at left with an arc power meter beside it. The whole challenge is contained in ONE fixed-camera screen. Flat ground supports the target structure, no platforming layout. Minimal HUD upper left three launch pips, top right "СЧЁТ 350". Bottom center tiny caption "ПРИЦЕЛЬСЯ • ОТПУСТИ • СНЕСИ ВСЁ". Clean bright flat 2D cartoon art, confident plum outlines, mint background and warm wood objects, soft small shadows, no elaborate fantasy scenery. Clearly physics game screenshot with objects at believable scale, not key art.
